package signature

import (
	"bufio"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"math/rand"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

// Golden generator for the Rust port: runs the real Go functions over a pool of signatures and
// JSON payloads and records the outputs. Run via `go test -overlay`; see crates/core/src/signature/testdata.

type gcase map[string]any

func errStr(err error) any {
	if err == nil {
		return nil
	}
	return err.Error()
}

func TestZZGolden(t *testing.T) {
	outPath := os.Getenv("GOLDEN_OUT")
	if outPath == "" {
		t.Skip("GOLDEN_OUT not set")
	}
	f, err := os.Create(outPath)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer f.Close()
	w := bufio.NewWriterSize(f, 1<<20)
	defer w.Flush()

	// ---- signature pool
	base := map[string]string{}
	add := func(name, sig string) { base[name] = sig }
	add("claudeE", testClaudeThinkingSignature())
	for _, n := range []int{0, 5, 35, 100} {
		add(fmt.Sprintf("claudeEopaque%d", n), testClaudeThinkingSignatureWithOpaqueLen(n))
	}
	add("claudeRunpadded", testUnpaddedAntigravityClaudeThinkingSignature())
	add("claudeR", base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(testClaudeThinkingSignature())))
	add("claudeEsimple", base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte{0x12, 0x34}))
	add("claudeRsimple", base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte{0x12, 0x34}))))
	add("claudeEfff", base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte{0x12, 0xFF, 0xFE, 0xFD}))
	add("cais_fable5", observedFable5Sample)
	add("caqs_fable51", observedFable51CAQSSample)
	add("caqs_narration", observedFable51CAQSNarrationSample)
	add("cais_opus5", testClaudeCAISSignature("claude-opus-5"))
	add("cais_unpadded", testUnpaddedClaudeCAISSignature())
	cais := func(name string, mod func(p *claudeCAISParts)) {
		p := defaultClaudeCAISParts("claude-opus-5")
		mod(&p)
		add("cais_"+name, p.encode())
	}
	cais("ch17", func(p *claudeCAISParts) { p.channelID = 17 })
	cais("env3", func(p *claudeCAISParts) { p.topEnvelope = 3 })
	cais("env4nokind", func(p *claudeCAISParts) { p.topEnvelope = 4; p.blockKind = "" })
	cais("notrailer", func(p *claudeCAISParts) { p.includeTopTrailer = false })
	cais("nochver", func(p *claudeCAISParts) { p.includeChannelVerion = false })
	cais("long", func(p *claudeCAISParts) { p.signatureLen = 96 })
	cais("nof7", func(p *claudeCAISParts) { p.includeField7 = false })
	cais("kindredacted", func(p *claudeCAISParts) { p.blockKind = "redacted_thinking" })
	cais("nokind", func(p *claudeCAISParts) { p.blockKind = "" })
	cais("noctx", func(p *claudeCAISParts) { p.contextID = "" })
	cais("model6", func(p *claudeCAISParts) { p.modelText = []byte("claude-opus-6-preview") })
	cais("nocontainer", func(p *claudeCAISParts) { p.includeContainer = false })
	cais("nochannel", func(p *claudeCAISParts) { p.includeChannelBlock = false })
	cais("nochid", func(p *claudeCAISParts) { p.includeChannelID = false })
	cais("chidbytes", func(p *claudeCAISParts) { p.channelIDAsBytes = true })
	cais("nosig", func(p *claudeCAISParts) { p.includeSignature = false })
	cais("emptysig", func(p *claudeCAISParts) { p.signatureLen = 0 })
	cais("nomodel", func(p *claudeCAISParts) { p.includeModelText = false })
	cais("foreignmodel", func(p *claudeCAISParts) { p.modelText = []byte("gemini-3-pro") })
	cais("badutf8", func(p *claudeCAISParts) { p.modelText = []byte{'c', 'l', 'a', 'u', 'd', 'e', '-', 0xff, 0xfe} })
	cais("baduuid", func(p *claudeCAISParts) { p.contextID = "not-a-canonical-uuid-value-000000000" })
	add("cais_wrongmarker", base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte{0x0a, 0x00}))
	add("classic_ef00", base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte{0x12, 0x00}))
	// Gemini
	add("gem_envelope", testGeminiThoughtSignatureEnvelope())
	add("gem25_field1", testGemini25Field1ThoughtSignatureEnvelope())
	add("gem_opaque3", testGeminiThoughtSignature([]byte{0x12, 0x34, 0x56}))
	add("gem3_tink", testGemini3ThoughtSignature(append([]byte{0x01, 0x0c, 0x39, 0xd6, 0xc7}, []byte("ciphertext-bytes-0123456789")...)))
	add("gem3_uuid", testGemini3ThoughtSignature([]byte("123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000")))
	add("gem3_nottink", testGemini3ThoughtSignature([]byte{0x02, 0x03, 0x04}))
	add("gem3_empty", testGemini3ThoughtSignature(nil))
	{
		// tool invocation payload: varint field, bytes field with tink payload, fixed32, fixed64
		var v []byte
		v = append(v, 0x08, 0x05)                // field1 varint 5
		v = append(v, 0x12, 0x04, 0x01, 1, 2, 3) // field2 bytes tink
		v = append(v, 0x2d, 1, 2, 3, 4)          // field5 fixed32
		v = append(v, 0x31, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8)
		add("gem3_toolinv", testGemini3ThoughtSignature(v))
		add("gem3_toolinv_trunc", testGemini3ThoughtSignature(v[:len(v)-3]))
		add("gem3_toolinv_group", testGemini3ThoughtSignature(append(append([]byte{}, v...), 0x0b)))
	}
	add("uuid_b64", base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte("123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000")))
	add("uuid_raw", "123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000")
	add("skip", GeminiSkipThoughtSignatureValidator)
	add("ctxeng", GeminiContextEngineeringBypass)
	add("gpt", testGPTReasoningSignature())
	{
		payload := make([]byte, 1+8+16+16+32)
		payload[0] = 0x81
		add("gpt_badver", "gAAAA"+base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString(payload)[5:])
		p2 := make([]byte, 1+8+16+10+32)
		p2[0] = 0x80
		add("gpt_badcipher", base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString(p2))
		p3 := make([]byte, 20)
		p3[0] = 0x80
		add("gpt_short", base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString(p3))
		p4 := make([]byte, 1+8+16+16+32+1)
		p4[0] = 0x80
		add("gpt_padded", base64.URLEncoding.EncodeToString(p4))
		sig := testGPTReasoningSignature()
		add("gpt_ellipsis", sig[:20]+string(rune(0x2026))+sig[20:])
	}
	add("kimi_ns", synthesizeKimiSignature(t, 9709, 1))
	add("kimi_s", synthesizeKimiSignature(t, 3255, 2))
	add("kimi_wronglen", synthesizeKimiSignature(t, 3000, 3))
	add("kimi_lowentropy", strings.Repeat("A", KimiThinkingSignatureStreamingLen))
	{
		g := synthesizeKimiSignature(t, 120, 7)
		add("grok_ok", g)
		g2 := synthesizeKimiSignature(t, 40, 8)
		add("grok_40", g2)
		add("grok_short", synthesizeKimiSignature(t, 20, 9))
		add("grok_lowentropy", base64.RawStdEncoding.EncodeToString(make([]byte, 64)))
		add("grok_padded", base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte("x")))
		add("grok_badchar", "ab$cdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOP")
	}
	add("sealed", "sealed.v1.abcdef")
	for _, s := range []string{"", " ", "abc", "E", "R", "C", "g", "E!!!invalid!!!", "Ebad", "gAAAAABopenai-encrypted-content", "opaque-deepseek-id", "K1ZAIbzDbO", "jQDLUr+fD8RFP8nbkkfI", "E\r\nQUI=", "EQUI", "ñ", "R" + strings.Repeat("A", 8)} {
		add("lit:"+s, s)
	}

	names := make([]string, 0, len(base))
	for k := range base {
		names = append(names, k)
	}
	sortStrings(names)
	var pool []string
	seen := map[string]int{}
	push := func(s string) {
		if _, ok := seen[s]; !ok {
			seen[s] = len(pool)
			pool = append(pool, s)
		}
	}
	prefixes := []string{"", "claude#", "gemini#", "gpt#", "swe#", "foo#", "ccmax#", "modelGroup#"}
	rng := rand.New(rand.NewSource(42))
	for _, name := range names {
		sig := base[name]
		push(sig)
		if len(sig) > 6000 { // keep the golden file small: no variants for huge signatures
			push("claude#" + sig)
			continue
		}
		for _, p := range prefixes[1:] {
			push(p + sig)
		}
		push("  " + sig + "\n")
		if len(sig) > 8 {
			push(sig[:len(sig)/2])
			push(sig[:len(sig)-1])
			b := []byte(sig)
			i := rng.Intn(len(b))
			b[i] = 'A' + byte(rng.Intn(26))
			push(string(b))
		}
	}
	// also decoded-garbled strings: random base64 junk starting with each envelope char
	for _, c := range "CERgAMNZ" {
		b := make([]byte, 60)
		rng.Read(b)
		push(string(c) + base64.RawStdEncoding.EncodeToString(b)[1:])
	}
	idx := func(s string) int { return seen[s] }
	enc := json.NewEncoder(w)
	enc.SetEscapeHTML(false)
	// out values equal to a pool signature are replaced by a reference to keep the file small.
	ref := func(v any) any {
		if s, ok := v.(string); ok {
			if i, ok := seen[s]; ok && len(s) > 64 {
				return map[string]int{"$sig": i}
			}
		}
		return v
	}
	emit := func(c gcase) {
		if o, ok := c["out"].(gcase); ok {
			for k, v := range o {
				o[k] = ref(v)
			}
		}
		if err := enc.Encode(c); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	emit(gcase{"fn": "pool", "sigs": pool})

	kinds := []SignatureBlockKind{SignatureBlockKindUnknown, SignatureBlockKindClaudeThinking, SignatureBlockKindGeminiModelPart, SignatureBlockKindGeminiFunctionCall, SignatureBlockKindGPTReasoning}
	targets := []SignatureProvider{SignatureProviderClaude, SignatureProviderGemini, SignatureProviderGeminiBypass, SignatureProviderGPT, SignatureProviderKimi, SignatureProviderGrok, SignatureProviderSWE, SignatureProviderUnknown}
	claudeOpts := []ClaudeSignatureValidationOptions{{}, {Strict: true}, {PrefixOnly: true}, {Base64Only: true}}
	for i, sig := range pool {
		for _, k := range kinds {
			emit(gcase{"fn": "detect", "sig": i, "kind": string(k), "out": gcase{"provider": string(DetectSignatureProviderForBlock(sig, k))}})
		}
		for _, tg := range targets {
			for _, k := range []SignatureBlockKind{SignatureBlockKindUnknown, SignatureBlockKindClaudeThinking, SignatureBlockKindGeminiFunctionCall} {
				d := DecideSignatureCompatibilityForModel(tg, "claude-opus-5", sig, k)
				emit(gcase{"fn": "decide", "sig": i, "target": string(tg), "kind": string(k), "model": "claude-opus-5", "out": gcase{
					"target": string(d.TargetProvider), "detected": string(d.DetectedProvider), "kind": string(d.BlockKind), "compatible": d.Compatible,
					"action": string(d.Action), "replacement": d.ReplacementSignature, "normalized": d.NormalizedSignature, "reason": d.Reason}})
			}
		}
		for oi, o := range claudeOpts {
			n, e := NormalizeClaudeThinkingSignature(sig, o)
			emit(gcase{"fn": "normalizeClaude", "sig": i, "opts": oi, "out": gcase{"value": n, "err": errStr(e)}})
			emit(gcase{"fn": "isValidClaude", "sig": i, "opts": oi, "out": gcase{"ok": IsValidClaudeThinkingSignature(sig, o)}})
			n2, e2 := NormalizeClaudeProviderNativeThinkingSignature(sig, o)
			emit(gcase{"fn": "normalizeNative", "sig": i, "opts": oi, "out": gcase{"value": n2, "err": errStr(e2)}})
		}
		emit(gcase{"fn": "decodable", "sig": i, "out": gcase{"ok": HasDecodableClaudeThinkingSignature(sig), "prefix": HasClaudeThinkingSignaturePrefix(sig)}})
		ci, ce := InspectClaudeCAISSignature(sig)
		cout := gcase{"err": errStr(ce)}
		if ci != nil {
			cout["info"] = gcase{"first": int(ci.FirstByte), "env": ci.EnvelopeVersion, "chan": ci.ChannelID, "model": ci.ModelText, "kind": ci.BlockKind, "ctx": ci.ContextID, "siglen": ci.SignatureLen}
		}
		emit(gcase{"fn": "inspectCAIS", "sig": i, "out": cout})
		for _, layer := range []struct {
			name string
			f    func(string) (*ClaudeSignatureTree, error)
		}{{"inspectSingle", InspectClaudeSingleLayerSignature}, {"inspectDouble", InspectClaudeDoubleLayerSignature}} {
			tr, te := layer.f(sig)
			tout := gcase{"err": errStr(te)}
			if tr != nil {
				var f2 any
				if tr.Field2 != nil {
					f2 = *tr.Field2
				}
				tout["tree"] = gcase{"layers": tr.EncodingLayers, "chan": tr.ChannelID, "field2": f2, "routing": tr.RoutingClass, "infra": tr.InfrastructureClass, "schema": tr.SchemaFeatures, "model": tr.ModelText, "legacy": tr.LegacyRouteHint, "f7": tr.HasField7}
			}
			emit(gcase{"fn": layer.name, "sig": i, "out": tout})
		}
		for oi, o := range []GeminiThoughtSignatureValidationOptions{{}, {AllowBypassSentinel: true}, {RequireKnownEnvelope: true}, {RequireObservedMarker: true}, {AllowBypassSentinel: true, RequireKnownEnvelope: true, RequireObservedMarker: true}} {
			gi, ge := InspectGeminiThoughtSignature(sig, o)
			gout := gcase{"err": errStr(ge)}
			if gi != nil {
				gout["info"] = gcase{"bypass": gi.IsBypassSentinel, "sentinel": gi.BypassSentinel, "dlen": gi.DecodedLen, "first": int(gi.FirstByte), "marker": gi.HasObservedMarker, "known": gi.KnownEnvelope, "envelope": string(gi.Envelope), "records": gi.RecordCount, "opaque": gi.OpaquePayloadLen}
			}
			emit(gcase{"fn": "inspectGemini", "sig": i, "opts": oi, "out": gout})
		}
		gp, gpe := InspectGPTReasoningSignature(sig)
		pout := gcase{"err": errStr(gpe)}
		if gp != nil {
			pout["info"] = gcase{"dlen": gp.DecodedLen, "clen": gp.CiphertextLen}
		}
		emit(gcase{"fn": "inspectGPT", "sig": i, "out": pout})
		gk, gke := InspectGrokEncryptedContent(sig)
		kout := gcase{"err": errStr(gke)}
		if gk != nil {
			kout["info"] = gcase{"raw": gk.RawLen, "dlen": gk.DecodedLen}
		}
		emit(gcase{"fn": "inspectGrok", "sig": i, "out": kout})
		ki, kie := InspectKimiThinkingSignature(sig)
		kiout := gcase{"err": errStr(kie)}
		if ki != nil {
			kiout["info"] = gcase{"raw": ki.RawLen, "dlen": ki.DecodedLen, "mode": string(ki.Mode)}
		}
		emit(gcase{"fn": "inspectKimi", "sig": i, "out": kiout})
		ag, agok := CompatibleAntigravityClaudeThinkingSignature(sig)
		emit(gcase{"fn": "compatAG", "sig": i, "out": gcase{"value": ag, "ok": agok}})
		emit(gcase{"fn": "recognized", "sig": i, "out": gcase{"ok": IsRecognizedReasoningSignature(sig)}})
		sp, sr, sok := SplitSignatureProviderPrefix(sig)
		emit(gcase{"fn": "split", "sig": i, "out": gcase{"provider": string(sp), "rest": sr, "ok": sok, "payload": SignaturePayloadWithoutProviderPrefix(sig)}})
		emit(gcase{"fn": "geminiReplay", "sig": i, "kind": "fc", "out": gcase{"value": GeminiReplaySignatureOrBypass(sig, SignatureBlockKindGeminiFunctionCall)}})
		emit(gcase{"fn": "geminiReplay", "sig": i, "kind": "mp", "out": gcase{"value": GeminiReplaySignatureOrBypass(sig, SignatureBlockKindGeminiModelPart)}})
	}
	for _, m := range []string{"claude-3", "Gemini-3", "gpt-5", "o3-mini", "o4", "k2.5", "kimi", "moonshot", "grok-4", "swe-1.5", "deepseek-v4", "", " CLAUDE ", "openai-x", "codex", "xo1"} {
		emit(gcase{"fn": "providerFromModel", "model": m, "out": gcase{"provider": string(SignatureProviderFromModelName(m))}})
	}
	for _, p := range []string{"claude", "Anthropic", " cais ", "claude-cais", "claude_cais", "ccmax", "claude-code-max", "claude_code_max", "gemini", "google", "openai", "gpt", "codex", "swe", "sealed", "foo", "", "claude-cache"} {
		emit(gcase{"fn": "providerFromPrefix", "prefix": p, "out": gcase{"provider": string(SignatureProviderFromCachePrefix(p))}})
	}

	// ---- JSON payloads
	sigPoolForJSON := []string{}
	for _, name := range []string{"claudeE", "claudeR", "claudeEsimple", "claudeEfff", "cais_fable5", "caqs_narration", "gem_envelope", "gem3_tink", "gem3_uuid", "uuid_b64", "skip", "ctxeng", "gpt", "sealed", "lit:", "lit:Ebad", "lit:opaque-deepseek-id", "lit:E!!!invalid!!!", "lit:gAAAAABopenai-encrypted-content", "lit: "} {
		sigPoolForJSON = append(sigPoolForJSON, base[name])
	}
	for _, p := range []string{"claude#", "gemini#", "foo#"} {
		sigPoolForJSON = append(sigPoolForJSON, p+base["claudeE"], p+base["gem_envelope"], p+base["skip"])
	}
	jsq := func(s string) string { b, _ := json.Marshal(s); return string(b) }
	// reference JSON signatures by pool index to keep payloads compact in the golden file.
	var payloads []string
	pstr := func(s string) string { return s }
	_ = pstr
	for _, s := range sigPoolForJSON {
		q := jsq(s)
		payloads = append(payloads,
			`{"messages":[{"role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"thinking","thinking":"t","signature":`+q+`},{"type":"text","text":"a"}]},{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"n"}]}]}`,
			`{"messages":[{"role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"thinking","thinking":"t","signature":`+q+`}]},{"role":"user","content":"hello"}]}`,
			`{"messages":[{"role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"thinking","thinking":"t","signature":`+q+`},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_1","name":"Bash","input":{"c":"pwd"},"signature":`+q+`,"thoughtSignature":`+q+`,"model":"claude-x","extra_content":{"google":{"thought_signature":`+q+`}}}]}]}`,
			`{"messages":[{"role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_1","name":"Bash","input":{},"extra_content":{"google":{"thought_signature":`+q+`}}}]}]}`,
			`{"messages":[{"role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"thinking","text":"","signature":`+q+`},{"type":"thinking","thinking":{"text":""},"signature":""},{"type":"thinking","thinking":{"thinking":"x"},"signature":`+q+`}]}]}`,
		)
	}
	payloads = append(payloads,
		`{"messages":[{"role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"thinking","thinking":"","signature":""}]}]}`,
		`{"messages":[{"role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"thinking","thinking":"   ","signature":" "},{"type":"thinking","text":"x","signature":""}]}]}`,
		`{"messages":[{"role":"assistant","content":"just text"},{"role":"user","content":[]}]}`,
		`{"messages":"nope"}`, `{"model":"x"}`, `[]`, `not json`, ``,
		"{\n  \"messages\": [\n    {\"role\": \"assistant\", \"content\": [ {\"type\":\"thinking\",\"thinking\":\"t\",\"signature\":\"gAAAAABzz\"}, {\"type\":\"text\",\"text\":\"a\"} ]}\n  ],\n  \"model\": \"m\"\n}",
	)
	targetModels := []string{"claude-sonnet-4-6", "gpt-5", "gemini-3-pro", "kimi-k2", "grok-4", "deepseek-v4", "swe-1", ""}
	for pi, p := range payloads {
		for _, o := range claudeOpts {
			emit(gcase{"fn": "stripInvalid", "payload": p, "opts": optIndex(claudeOpts, o), "out": gcase{"value": string(StripInvalidClaudeThinkingBlocks([]byte(p), o))}})
			emit(gcase{"fn": "stripInvalidEmpty", "payload": p, "opts": optIndex(claudeOpts, o), "out": gcase{"value": string(StripInvalidClaudeThinkingBlocksAndEmptyMessages([]byte(p), o))}})
			emit(gcase{"fn": "validateClaude", "payload": p, "opts": optIndex(claudeOpts, o), "out": gcase{"err": errStr(ValidateClaudeThinkingSignatures([]byte(p), o))}})
		}
		emit(gcase{"fn": "stripAllowEmpty", "payload": p, "out": gcase{"value": string(StripInvalidClaudeThinkingBlocks([]byte(p), ClaudeSignatureValidationOptions{Base64Only: true, AllowEmptySignatureWithEmptyText: true}))}})
		for _, m := range targetModels {
			out, rep := SanitizeClaudeMessagesSignaturesForModel([]byte(p), m)
			emit(gcase{"fn": "sanitizeForModel", "payload": p, "model": m, "out": reportOut(out, rep)})
			for _, preserve := range []bool{false, true} {
				out, rep := SanitizeClaudeMessagesForClaudeUpstream([]byte(p), m, preserve)
				emit(gcase{"fn": "sanitizeForClaudeUpstream", "payload": p, "model": m, "preserve": preserve, "out": reportOut(out, rep)})
			}
		}
		_ = pi
	}
	// target-options variants
	for _, p := range payloads[:40] {
		for _, drop := range []bool{false, true} {
			out, rep := SanitizeClaudeMessagesSignaturesForTarget([]byte(p), ClaudeMessagesSignatureSanitizeOptions{TargetProvider: SignatureProviderGemini, TargetModel: "gemini-3", DropEmptyMessages: drop, DropToolSignatures: false})
			emit(gcase{"fn": "sanitizeForTargetGemini", "payload": p, "drop": drop, "out": reportOut(out, rep)})
			out, rep = SanitizeClaudeMessagesSignaturesForTarget([]byte(p), ClaudeMessagesSignatureSanitizeOptions{TargetProvider: SignatureProviderClaude, TargetModel: "claude-x", DropEmptyMessages: drop, DropToolSignatures: false})
			emit(gcase{"fn": "sanitizeForTargetClaudeKeepTools", "payload": p, "drop": drop, "out": reportOut(out, rep)})
			out, rep = SanitizeClaudeMessagesSignaturesForTarget([]byte(p), ClaudeMessagesSignatureSanitizeOptions{TargetProvider: SignatureProviderGPT, DropEmptyMessages: drop})
			emit(gcase{"fn": "sanitizeForTargetGPT", "payload": p, "drop": drop, "out": reportOut(out, rep)})
			out, rep = SanitizeClaudeMessagesSignaturesForTarget([]byte(p), ClaudeMessagesSignatureSanitizeOptions{TargetProvider: SignatureProviderClaude, TargetModel: "claude-x", DropEmptyMessages: drop, DropEmptyThinkingPlaceholders: false})
			emit(gcase{"fn": "sanitizeForTargetClaudePlaceholders", "payload": p, "drop": drop, "out": reportOut(out, rep)})
		}
	}

	// Gemini payloads
	gsigs := []string{}
	for _, name := range []string{"gem_envelope", "gem3_tink", "gem3_uuid", "uuid_b64", "skip", "ctxeng", "claudeE", "cais_fable5", "gpt", "lit:", "lit:abc", "gem3_toolinv", "gem25_field1"} {
		gsigs = append(gsigs, base[name])
	}
	gsigs = append(gsigs, "gemini#"+base["gem_envelope"], "gemini#"+base["skip"], "claude#"+base["claudeE"], " "+base["skip"]+" ")
	var gpayloads []string
	wrap := func(contents string) []string {
		return []string{`{"contents":` + contents + `}`, `{"request":{"contents":` + contents + `},"model":"m"}`}
	}
	for _, s := range gsigs {
		q := jsq(s)
		for _, c := range []string{
			`[{"role":"user","parts":[{"text":"hi"}]},{"role":"model","parts":[{"functionCall":{"id":"c1","name":"f","args":{}},"thoughtSignature":` + q + `}]},{"role":"user","parts":[{"functionResponse":{"id":"c1","name":"f","response":{}}}]}]`,
			`[{"role":"model","parts":[{"functionCall":{"id":"c1","name":"f","args":{}}},{"functionCall":{"id":"c2","name":"g","args":{}},"thoughtSignature":` + q + `}]}]`,
			`[{"role":"model","parts":[{"functionCall":{"name":"f","args":{}},"thought_signature":` + q + `},{"text":"x","thoughtSignature":` + q + `}]}]`,
			`[{"role":"model","parts":[{"text":"x","thoughtSignature":` + q + `},{"thought":true,"text":"y"},{"functionCall":{"name":"f","args":{}}}]}]`,
			`[{"role":"user","parts":[{"functionResponse":{"name":"f","response":{}},"thoughtSignature":` + q + `}]}]`,
			`[{"role":"model","parts":[{"functionCall":{"name":"f","args":{},"thoughtSignature":` + q + `}}]}]`,
			`[{"role":"model","parts":[{"toolCall":{"x":1},"thoughtSignature":` + q + `},{"toolResponse":{"x":1},"thoughtSignature":` + q + `},{"tool_call":{},"thought_signature":` + q + `},{"functionCall":{"name":"f","args":{}}}]}]`,
			`[{"role":"model","parts":[{"functionCall":{"name":"f","args":{}},"thoughtSignature":` + q + `,"thought_signature":` + q + `,"extra_content":{"google":{"thought_signature":` + q + `}}}]}]`,
			`[{"role":"MODEL","parts":[{"functionCall":{"name":"f","args":{}},"thoughtSignature":` + q + `}]},{"role":" model ","parts":[{"functionCall":{"name":"f","args":{}}}]}]`,
			`[{"role":"model","parts":[{"functionCall":{"name":"f"},"extra_content":{"google":{"thought_signature":` + q + `}}}]}]`,
			`[{"role":"model","parts":[{"functionCall":{"name":"f"},"thoughtSignature":123}]}]`,
		} {
			gpayloads = append(gpayloads, wrap(c)...)
		}
	}
	gpayloads = append(gpayloads,
		`{"contents":[{"role":"model","parts":[]},{"role":"user"},{"role":"model","parts":"x"}]}`,
		`{"contents":"x"}`, `{}`, `[]`, ``, `nope`,
		`{"contents":[{"role":"model","parts":[{"functionCall":{"id":"a","name":"f"}},{"functionCall":{"id":"b","name":"g"}}]},{"role":"user","parts":[{"functionResponse":{"id":"a","name":"f"}},{"functionResponse":{"id":"b","name":"g"}}]}]}`,
		`{"contents":[{"role":"model","parts":[{"functionCall":{"id":"a","name":"f"}}]},{"role":"user","parts":[{"text":"reminder"}]},{"role":"user","parts":[{"functionResponse":{"id":"a","name":"f"}}]}]}`,
		`{"contents":[{"role":"model","parts":[{"functionCall":{"id":"a","name":"f"}}]},{"role":"model","parts":[{"text":"x"}]}]}`,
		`{"contents":[{"role":"model","parts":[{"functionCall":{"id":"a","name":"f"}}]},{"role":"user","parts":[{"functionResponse":{"name":"f"}}]}]}`,
		`{"contents":[{"role":"model","parts":[{"functionCall":{"id":"a","name":"f"}}]},{"role":"user","parts":[{"functionResponse":{"id":"z","name":"f"}}]}]}`,
		`{"contents":[{"role":"model","parts":[{"functionCall":{"id":"a","name":"f"}}]},{"role":"user","parts":[{"functionResponse":{"id":"a"}}]}]}`,
		`{"contents":[{"role":"model","parts":[{"functionCall":{"id":"a","name":"f"}}]},{"role":"user","parts":[{"functionResponse":{"id":"a","name":"g"}}]}]}`,
		`{"contents":[{"role":"model","parts":[{"functionCall":{"id":"a","name":"f"}}]},{"role":"user","parts":[{"functionResponse":{"id":"a","name":"f"}},{"functionResponse":{"id":"b","name":"g"}}]}]}`,
		`{"contents":[{"role":"user","parts":[{"functionResponse":{"id":"a","name":"f"}}]}]}`,
		`{"contents":[{"role":"model","parts":[{"functionCall":{"id":"a"}}]}]}`,
		`{"contents":[{"role":"model","parts":[{"functionCall":{"id":"a","name":"f"},"functionResponse":{"id":"a","name":"f"}}]}]}`,
		`{"contents":[{"role":"model","parts":[{"functionCall":{"id":"a","name":"f"}}]},{"role":"model","parts":[{"functionCall":{"id":"b","name":"f"}}]}]}`,
		`{"contents":[{"role":"model","parts":[{"functionCall":{"id":"a","name":"f"}}]},{"role":"user","parts":[]}]}`,
		`{"contents":[{"role":"model","parts":[{"functionCall":{"name":"f"}}]},{"role":"user","parts":[{"functionResponse":{"name":"f"}}]}]}`,
	)
	gopts := []GeminiThoughtSignatureValidationOptions{{}, {AllowBypassSentinel: true}, {AllowBypassSentinel: true, RequireKnownEnvelope: true}, {RequireObservedMarker: true, AllowBypassSentinel: true}}
	for _, p := range gpayloads {
		for oi, o := range gopts {
			emit(gcase{"fn": "validateGemini", "payload": p, "opts": oi, "out": gcase{"err": errStr(ValidateGeminiThoughtSignatures([]byte(p), o))}})
		}
		emit(gcase{"fn": "pairing", "payload": p, "out": gcase{"err": errStr(ValidateGeminiFunctionCallPairing([]byte(p)))}})
		emit(gcase{"fn": "sanitizeGemini", "payload": p, "path": "contents", "out": gcase{"value": string(SanitizeGeminiRequestThoughtSignatures([]byte(p), "contents"))}})
		emit(gcase{"fn": "sanitizeGemini", "payload": p, "path": "request.contents", "out": gcase{"value": string(SanitizeGeminiRequestThoughtSignatures([]byte(p), "request.contents"))}})
		emit(gcase{"fn": "sanitizeGemini", "payload": p, "path": "  ", "out": gcase{"value": string(SanitizeGeminiRequestThoughtSignatures([]byte(p), "  "))}})
	}
	_ = idx
}

func optIndex(opts []ClaudeSignatureValidationOptions, o ClaudeSignatureValidationOptions) int {
	for i, c := range opts {
		if c == o {
			return i
		}
	}
	return -1
}

func reportOut(out []byte, rep SignatureSanitizeReport) gcase {
	decs := []gcase{}
	for _, d := range rep.Decisions {
		decs = append(decs, gcase{"target": string(d.TargetProvider), "detected": string(d.DetectedProvider), "kind": string(d.BlockKind), "compatible": d.Compatible, "action": string(d.Action), "replacement": d.ReplacementSignature, "normalized": d.NormalizedSignature, "reason": d.Reason})
	}
	return gcase{"value": string(out), "target": string(rep.TargetProvider), "preserved": rep.Preserved, "droppedBlocks": rep.DroppedBlocks, "droppedSignatures": rep.DroppedSignatures, "replaced": rep.ReplacedSignatures, "decisions": decs}
}

func sortStrings(s []string) {
	for i := 1; i < len(s); i++ {
		for j := i; j > 0 && s[j] < s[j-1]; j-- {
			s[j], s[j-1] = s[j-1], s[j]
		}
	}
}
